entries.title: Esther 2:1
segments: What is done in a passion is often a source of deep regret; and if men do not change their conduct, but continue in sin and folly, choosing rather to do this than to acknowledge their error, they must in the end by miserable, eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

entries.title: Esther 2:4
segments: Sin in prospect appears to those who love it very different from what it does after it has been committed.  It promises good; but at last, bites like a serpent and stings like an adder.

entries.title: Esther 2:7
segments:
Hadassah; her Hebrew name, signifying, Myrtle. 
 
  Esther; the Persian name given her upon her advancement to the dignity of queen.  It signifies, Star. 
 
Kindness to orphans is well-pleasing to God, and he often follows it with special manifestatons of his favor.

entries.title: Esther 2:10
segments: Ability and disposition to keep secret what should not be published, is a valuable trait of character, and should be cultivated by all who are intrusted with great and important concerns.

entries.title: Esther 2:16
segments: In the seventh year of his reign; about four years after the divorce of Vashti,

. 
 
God is able to overrule those actions of men that are in themselves neither wise nor righteous, for the accomplishment of his own most wise and righteous counsels.  Thus the divorce Vashti prepared the way for the elevation of Esther to the royal dignity, with all its important consequences to the Jewish people.

entries.title: Esther 2:17
segments: When God sees best, he can give his people favor even with those who rebel against him; and all the influence he gives to any should be employed to promote his glory and the good of men.

entries.title: Esther 2:18
segments: A release; a remission of tribute.

entries.title: Esther 2:19
segments:
Were gathered together the second time; the meaning of these words is not certain; they may refer to a second gathering of fair virgins from whom concubines for the king were to be selected, after that first gathering for the choice of a queen. 
 
  Sat in the king's gate; these words imply that he had received an office in the king's palace, and sat in his gate, according to the custom at the Persian court, ready to discharge whatever duties might be required of him.

entries.title: Esther 2:21
segments:
Sought to lay hand on the king; conspired against his life. 
 
While the wicked are devising wicked devices and seeking the ruin of others, God may be preparing to overrule it for their own destruction, and for the salvation of his people.

entries.title: Esther 2:23
segments: The book of the chronicles; the register of the affairs of the kingdom, kept in the royal palace.
